Kyunki maine ek promise kiya tha — unse.

parsed.self_critique_fixed: Applied the 'Family / narrative drama' register to maintain a highly emotional, conversational, and natural tone. Avoided Sanskritized terms (like prarthana or prayas) in favor of colloquial terms (prayers, koshish). Ensured the hook opens with native words ('Maine apna gaon chhoda...'). Kept the quoted English line in Scene 1 verbatim as per T2a. Maintained respectful tone (T4) for parents ('Aapka beta', 'aapko proud') and Miss Nova ('samajhti hain', 'karti hain').
